description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific Stripe refund by ID. Use when you need to get information about an existing refund.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for retrieving a refund.

refund.description: The unique identifier for the refund to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 're_'.
refund.title: Refund

inputSchema.title: GetRefundsRefundRequest

name: get_refunds_refund

network_decline_code.description: Network decline code indicating why the refund failed.
network_decline_code.title: Network Decline Code

reference.description: Assigned reference identifier for the card refund.
reference.title: Reference

reference_status.description: Status of the reference. Possible values: pending, available, unavailable.
reference_status.title: Reference Status

card.description: Card-specific destination data if type is 'card'.
card.title: Card

type.description: The destination type for the refund (e.g., 'card').
type.title: Type

DisplayDetails.description: Refund details for user display when action is required.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the refund action expires.
expires_at.title: Expires At

DisplayDetails.title: DisplayDetails

EmailSent.description: Information about the notification email sent to customer.

email_sent_at.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the notification email was sent.
email_sent_at.title: Email Sent At

email_sent_to.description: Email address to which the notification was sent.
email_sent_to.title: Email Sent To

EmailSent.title: EmailSent

GetRefundsRefundResponse.description: Response containing detailed information about the refund.

amount.description: Amount refunded in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD).
amount.title: Amount

balance_transaction.description: Balance transaction ID that describes the impact on your account balance.
balance_transaction.title: Balance Transaction

charge.description: ID of the charge that was refunded.
charge.title: Charge

created.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the object was created.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd').
currency.title: Currency

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object (non-card refunds only).
description.title: Description

failure_balance_transaction.description: Balance transaction ID describing the adjustment after refund failure.
failure_balance_transaction.title: Failure Balance Transaction

failure_reason.description: Reason for refund failure. Possible values: lost_or_stolen_card, expired_or_canceled_card, charge_for_pending_refund_disputed, insufficient_funds, declined, merchant_request, unknown.
failure_reason.title: Failure Reason

id.description: Unique identifier for the refund object.
id.title: Id

instructions_email.description: Email address for refund instructions on payment methods without native refund support.
instructions_email.title: Instructions Email

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

next_action.description: Properties describing required actions when status is 'requires_action'.
next_action.title: Next Action

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'refund'.
object.title: Object

payment_intent.description: ID of the PaymentIntent that was refunded.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

pending_reason.description: Reason refund is pending. Possible values: processing, insufficient_funds, charge_pending.
pending_reason.title: Pending Reason

reason.description: User-provided or Stripe-generated refund reason. Possible values: duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer, expired_uncaptured_charge.
reason.title: Reason

receipt_number.description: Transaction number that appears on email receipts sent for this refund.
receipt_number.title: Receipt Number

source_transfer_reversal.description: The transfer reversal that's associated with the refund.
source_transfer_reversal.title: Source Transfer Reversal

status.description: Current status of the refund. Possible values: pending, requires_action, succeeded, failed, canceled.
status.title: Status

transfer_reversal.description: Transfer reversal object if the accompanying transfer reverses.
transfer_reversal.title: Transfer Reversal

GetRefundsRefundResponse.title: GetRefundsRefundResponse

NextAction.description: Properties describing required next actions when status is 'requires_action'.

display_details.description: Refund details for user display when action is required.
display_details.title: Display Details

type.description: Type of the next action required (e.g., 'display_details').
type.title: Type

NextAction.title: NextAction
